answer: Trust the check, not the claimant: Harvester pruned hedge seal witnessed at the compost tally is the check, and it reads 6-year garden service, 56 supervised plantings, trowel exam, annual ledger fees. One agent, one proof, 101 POA. 429 agents, 429 proofs, 43329 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. The zephyr arrives by post, the jetty arrives by bank transfer, and the pulse arrives by archive: none of them can be hurried. Everything above is checkable from public records; nothing here rests on trust.
